column5: {"text":"Attack R1 open-ended: overlap no longer deletes or hides by itself; Add to is cut; reader values keep ownership marks; windows come from timer and check stamps"}

{"text":"Attack R2 open-ended on ownership marks: design 3 lets the reader write only session_hr, stores the range at Finish, timer commit and import, computes round averages when shown, cuts measured distance"}
{"text":"Attack R3 open-ended on the gym wall clock: one verified-clock rule for gym and timer, timerRun identity, anchor at Start"}
{"text":"Attack R4 open-ended on legacy inference: migration gives ranges only to band imports, old gym range only by owner confirmation, old pairs placed by measured duration"}
{"text":"Attack R5 open-ended on the old-pair merge: no automatic delete, the owner merges listed pairs by hand"}
{"text":"Attack R6 open-ended on timer run order: run numbers without a clock; mergePairs checks the rows the owner saw"}
{"text":"Attack R7 open-ended on the timer duration write: duration only over the value noted at Start; the combined attack ends, later phases get their own round"}
